title: Lahore Development Authority Land Use Rules 2014

sections.shortTitle: Lahore Development Authority Land Use Rules 2014
sections.section: RULE - Lahore Development Authority Land Use Rules 2014
sections.description:
LAHORE DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY
LAHORE DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY
LAND USE RULES, 2014
(Amendments)
[Gazette of Punjab Extraordinary,
23rd October, 2017]
No. SO(H-II)3-2/2016, dated 5.5.2017.---In exercise of the powers conferred under
section 44 of the Lahore Development Authority Act, 1975 (XXX of 1975),
Governor of the Punjab is pleased to direct that in the Lahore Development
Authority Land Use Rules 2014, the following amendments shall be made:
In the said Rules:
(1) In rule
3, in sub-rule (2), for clause (b), the following shall be substituted:
"(b) Permissible uses:---The uses,
though not included in the permitted uses mentioned under clause (a), may be
allowed by the scrutiny committee as land use subject to:
(i) payment
of the prescribed fee mentioned under the table in rule 28; and
(ii) fulfilment
of other conditions imposed by the scrutiny committee.".
(2) In rule
4, in clause (b), in the heading, after colon, the expression "(subject to
payment of fee)" shall be omitted.
(3) In rule
6, in sub-rule (2), in clause (b), for sub-clause (ii), the following shall be
substituted:
"(ii) petrol pump, gas station, LPG or LNG
storage or filling station;".
(4) In rule
7, in clause (b), in the heading, after colon, the expression "(subject to
payment of fee)" shall be omitted.
(5) In rule
8, in clause (b), in the heading, after colon, the expression (subject to
payment of fee)" shall be omitted.
(6) In rule
12, in clause (b):
(a) for
sub-clause (viii), the following shall be substituted;
"(viii) CNG station, petrol pump, LPG or LNG
storage or filing station;".
(b) in
sub-clause (xiv), the word "and" shall be omitted;
(c) in
sub-clause (xv), for full stop, the expression "; and" shall be
substituted; and
(d) after
sub-clause (xv), the following sub-clause (xvi) shall be inserted:
"(xvi) oil depot or storage.".
(7) In rule
28:
(a) in
sup-rule (1), in the Table, for Sr. No. (IV), the following shall be
substituted:
LAND USE
RATES
"IV. On
permissible uses under rule 3(2)(b)
(a) twenty percent of
the commercial value of the total area of ownership, as provided In valuation
table. (b) Notwithstanding anything contained in the provision mentioned at
Sr. No I, five percent of the prevailing sale price of the land as per
valuation table of the relevant category for the permissible use of heavy
industry under sub-clause (i) of clause (b) of sub-rule (2) of rule 6. Explanation:
(i) For determination of value as mentioned under clauses (a) and (b),
the matter shall be . referred to the concerned District Collector for
assessment of land price on case to case basis. (ii) If valuation table is
not available, for the purposes mentioned under clauses (a) and (b), the
average sale price of preceding twelve months of commercial land in vicinity
shall be considered. (iii) If the owner of the premises has already paid the
conversion fee for institutional uses and intends to get the property
commercialized subject to provision of rules he shall pay only ten percent
commercialization fee on prevailing rates. (iv) If the owner of the premises
has already paid the conversion fee and seeks permission for permissible
uses, the conversion fee shall not be applicable."; and
(b) after sub-rule (6), the following sub-rule
(7) shall be inserted:
"(7) Notwithstanding anything contained in the
rates mentioned under sub-rule (1), the conversion fee, for the conversion of
land use to educational or healthcare institutional, shall be as follows:
(a) ten
percent of the value of the commercial land as per valuation table; or
(b) ten
percent of the average sale price of commercial land in the vicinity in the
preceding twelve months, if valuation table is not available.".
(8) In rule
34, after sub-rule (3), the following sub-rule (4) shall be inserted:
"(4) The Authority may allow conversion of
land in lieu of the land surrendered for road network subject to the following
conditions:
(a) the
commercialization of land shall be notified, if:
(i) land is
acquired for the roads;
